scripts.test: npm run test:branding && npm run test:identity-setup && npm run test:local-chrome && node --test test/release-engineering.test.mjs
scripts.release-check: npm run test && npm run check && npm run package && node scripts/validate-npm-pack.mjs
scripts.build:local-chrome: npm run build:bridge && npm run build:codex-mcp && npm run build:extension
scripts.check:local-chrome: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build:local-chrome && npx tsc -p apps/chrome-bridge/tsconfig.json --noEmit && npx tsc -p apps/codex-mcp-server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && npx tsc -p apps/extension/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test:local-chrome: npm run build -w packages/browser-protocol -w apps/chrome-bridge -w apps/codex-mcp-server && node --test packages/browser-protocol/test/*.test.mjs apps/chrome-bridge/test/*.test.mjs apps/codex-mcp-server/test/*.test.mjs
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w packages/shared -w packages/agent-core && concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/server" "npm run dev:web -w apps/desktop"
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w packages/shared -w packages/agent-core && npm run build:web -w apps/desktop && npm run build -w apps/server
scripts.install-local-chrome: npm run build:local-chrome && node apps/chrome-bridge/dist/install.js install
scripts.install-host: npm run build -w apps/host && node apps/host/dist/install.js install
